categories.name: Big Hearts
categories.description: Every Big Heart that permanently adds a heart to Mike's life meter (one each in Chapters 3, 4, 5 and 6).

categories.name: Tetrads
categories.description: All seven mystic Tetrads, one at the end of each chapter from 2 to 8; each one also raises the life meter.

categories.name: Weapons & Psychic Powers
categories.description: Every main weapon (Axe, Dagger, Katana), every sub-weapon pickup named by an achievement (Rocks, Slingshot, Spiked Frisbee, Bola, Triple Spike Ball) and all three Psychic Shock Wave upgrades.

playthrough_notes: One playthrough covers every achievement. A commenter on the achievement page notes that any earlier chapter can be replayed from the File Select screen, so a chapter-specific achievement you miss can be earned by replaying that chapter. The route still takes everything on the first pass, including the dagger from the Jack of All Trades in Chapter 3, which must be accepted before Cleopatra hands over her own dagger.
settings_notes: Hardcore Mode. The game has no difficulty setting that affects the achievements.

missables.label: Dagger from the Jack of All Trades
missables.deadline: Before giving Cleopatra her pizza in Chapter 3. Once you hold a dagger, Jack only offers to trade back for an axe, and Cleopatra only hands over her dagger when you arrive without one.

chapters.title: Prelude
chapters.notes: Story prologue on C-Island with Dr. Jones decoding Hirocon's message. Answer YES when asked if you understand, then read the magic words from the Oxford Wonder World to travel to the Ice Age. No achievements here.

chapters.title: The Ice Age
chapters.notes: Pick up the Rocks first (Better Than Nothing), then get the Axe from Tink in Cave Men Cave (A Caveman Weapon). In Yum Yum's Cave, clear the second room to open the secret passage back to the first Medicine (Just Like Link: the achievement's 'Potion' is the game's Medicine). Defeat Yum Yum and take the Tetrad block for Your First Tetrad.

chapters.title: Cleopatra's Egypt
chapters.notes: Right where you arrive, go north and walk between the two palm trees on the right side of the screen to reach the Jack of All Trades. Answer Yes to his trade: his bronze dagger earns both Jack of All Trades and Sharp Edge. Do this before the pizza is delivered, because Cleopatra only offers her dagger to a Mike who has none, and with a dagger in hand Jack only offers an axe. Then talk to everyone on the barge so the guard lets you in, take Cleopatra's pizza errand, clear Border Pass (the Slingshot chest is the 'Thrower' achievement), ride the rented camel to the pizza courier, and deliver the pizza. Across the Nile, the Monkey Savannah maze holds the Big Heart (two guides give different step counts for the path; give both) and the mini-dungeons where enemies drop small stars: collect them until you hold four at once for What Do These Do? (see the open question). The monkey at the end teaches the Psychic Shock Wave, needed to enter the Pyramid. Inside, get the Flute from the chest, then beat Monster Mask for the Tetrad.

chapters.title: Holmes's London
chapters.notes: Meet Sherlock Holmes, watch Zoda-X take the stone at the museum, and escape the jail through its east wall. Before the sewer dungeon, take the open manhole on the left for the Big Heart (Down the Sewers). In the second sewer, the chest in the room with three Zoda spawns holds the spiked frisbees, the 'Spike Ball' item of That Does NOT Look Like a Ball. Defeat Zoda-X for the Tetrad.

chapters.title: The Wild West
chapters.notes: Get dynamite from Bob's store and listen to the saloon piano player's tune. Before entering any tunnel, blast the caves along the trail of lighter rocks on the mountain: one cave holds a 'gold nugget' that turns out to be a chicken nugget (Not Quite a Gold Nugget), another holds the real gold nugget (Real Gold). A commenter counts four secret passages besides the main entrance; open them all. Blast between the two boulders low on the west wall for the Big Heart (Heart of Gold). In the Gold Cave, open the chest for the Bola. Past its boss, the donkey teaches the Super Psychic Shock Wave. In the second cave, take the invincibility star from a switch-opened chest (Just Like Mario), then beat the hammer-swinging miner for the Tetrad.

chapters.title: Leonardo's Italy
chapters.notes: In the building with the plaster statue, go down to the basement and knock every ball into the holes in both rooms to get the hammer and chisel. Chip Leonardo free for the Katana (Now We Got a Sword) and the flying machine. When the flying machine lands, walk to the mountain wall on the west side for the Big Heart before entering the castle (Heart on the Lone Island). Inside the castle maze, watch for pits, and take the Tetrad at the end (Watch Out for Pits!).

chapters.title: Dracula's Transylvania
chapters.notes: In the castle, take the Spike Balls from the chest on the east wall of the room with the hole in the middle before dropping down (Triple the Fun). Defeat Zoda-Y and take the Tetrad (House of the Undead).

chapters.title: King Arthur's Camelot
chapters.notes: Agree to help King Arthur (do not answer No); he knights you, raises your life level and the guard lets you through. Beat the Knight in the first cave; Merlin then teaches the Ultra Psychic Shock Wave (it needs at least 10 hearts to use). Defeat the Dragon in the second cave for the last Tetrad (The Middle Ages).

chapters.title: Return to C-Island
chapters.notes: Enter the cave behind the boy in Coralcola. Beat the C-Serpent, take the bottom conveyor route for the most medicines, then refight faster versions of earlier bosses before Zoda-Z. Defeat all of Zoda-Z's forms and watch the ending for C-Island is Normal Again!

open_questions.question: Which 'stars' does What Do These Do? (Have 4 stars at once) count: the small stars dropped by enemies (five of them refill a heart), or the Invincibility Stars stored as Magic Items?
open_questions.guidance: No source settles it. The set lists it among the Chapter 3 achievements, and the Chapter 3 savannah mini-dungeons are where enemies drop stars, so collect dropped small stars there until you hold four, without picking up a fifth. If it has not unlocked by Chapter 5, keep both Invincibility Stars from the second Gold Cave unused in your Magic Items rather than spending them on the boss.

open_questions.question: Does Jack of All Trades also unlock when the dagger comes from Cleopatra instead of Jack?
open_questions.guidance: Two commenters say it unlocked for them without Jack's trade, but the achievement names the Jack of All Trades as the source. Accept Jack's trade (answer Yes) before delivering the pizza, and never decline it.

open_questions.question: Does Sharp Edge unlock reliably on current emulators?
open_questions.guidance: One commenter reported it not unlocking on RANes or RetroArch; the achievement was edited and re-promoted afterwards. Take the dagger as routed; if it does not unlock, replay Chapter 3 from the File Select screen.
